title: FLA import: close stale task 0885 and fix blank-stage regression in Magnet.fla after 0890/0891 land
description:
Context: Magnet.fla still renders a black/blank stage in Ruffle after tasks 0889 (CS2 class tags) and 0886 (layer names) were fixed.

Root causes still in-progress:
- 0890: DefineShape4 invalid fill style → black shapes
- 0891: JPEG bitmaps missing EOI marker → Ruffle bitmap decode failure
- 0892: CPicSwf embedded SWF symbols dropped

Task 0885 ('unrecognised class tags') is functionally resolved (class-tag parsing errors are gone) but its status is still 'open'. This task is a verification + cleanup:

1. After 0890 and 0891 are done, publish Magnet.fla and confirm Ruffle renders recognisable content (not blank/black)
2. Close task 0885 with evidence (screenshot comparison or pixel-diff)
3. Identify and file any remaining rendering gaps specific to Magnet.fla
4. Use the same Playwright/Ruffle oracle approach used in the capstone (task 0519)

This task gates the 'Magnet.fla fully renders in Ruffle' milestone.
